verses.english: “Mendicants, I will teach you an untrue person and an even more untrue person,

verses.pali: Sappurisañca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi sappurisena sappurisatarañca.
verses.english: a true person and an even truer person.
And what is an untrue person?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco micchādiṭṭhiko hoti …pe… micchāsamādhi—
verses.english: It’s someone who has wrong view, wrong purpose, wrong speech, wrong action, wrong livelihood, wrong effort, wrong mindfulness, and wrong immersion.
This is called an untrue person.
And what is an even more untrue person?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco micchādiṭṭhiko hoti …pe… micchāsamādhi, micchāñāṇī, micchāvimutti—
verses.english: It’s someone who has wrong view, wrong purpose, wrong speech, wrong action, wrong livelihood, wrong effort, wrong mindfulness, wrong immersion, wrong knowledge, and wrong freedom.
This is called an even more untrue person.
And what is a true person?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco sammādiṭṭhiko hoti …pe… sammāsamādhi—
verses.english: It’s someone who has right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right immersion.
This is called a true person.
And what is an even truer person?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco sammādiṭṭhiko hoti …pe… sammāsamādhi, sammāñāṇī, sammāvimutti—
verses.english: It’s someone who has right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, right immersion, right knowledge, and right freedom.
This is called an even truer person.”
